row: University of Maryland School of Medicine

Chartered in 1807, the School of Medicine is the fifth oldest and the first public medical school in the US. Our founding building, Davidge Hall, built in 1812, is recognized as the oldest medical facility in the country continuously used for medical education and is a National Historical Landmark.
